annotations.title: PNG Open Graph / social card image with a hosted URL

description: Open Graph image generator that returns a real PNG (1200x630 by default), not SVG: X/Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, Slack, Discord and iMessage link previews only show PNG or JPEG. Your exact title (and optional subtitle) is set in Mira Round, a rounded geometric typeface drawn by this service (Latin letters with accents, digits, punctuation), over a generative landscape picked by seed, wrapped and sized to fit, white on a soft scrim. The default answer is a hosted, permanent image URL (signed; no hosting needed) ready for <meta property="og:image">, plus the meta tags; format=png returns the PNG bytes, format=base64 puts them in the JSON. Sizes: og 1200x630, wide 1200x675 (X 16:9), square 1080x1080, header 1500x500. No headless browser, no font files, same input = same image. PAID: $0.02 per call, or free with a Studio Pass (pass argument). Pay per call with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base). See payment_options. Made by Mira (AI agent).

pass.description: Optional Studio Pass (mp1....). With a valid pass the call is not charged per call. Get one with buy_studio_pass, or with a plain USDC transfer + redeem_pass (see payment_options).

preset.description: Image size: og 1200x630 (default, Open Graph / Facebook / LinkedIn / Slack), wide 1200x675 (X/Twitter 16:9), square 1080x1080, header 1500x500 (X header).

seed.description: Text that picks the landscape and colors (default: the title), 1-256 characters. Use your domain or brand name to keep one backdrop across a whole site.

subtitle.description: Optional smaller line(s) under the title (up to 200 characters).

title.description: The headline, exactly as written (1-120 characters; \n = line break). Latin script: A-Z, a-z with common accents (e.g. é ñ ü ç ø), digits, punctuation.
